name: Hello! Trick? Treat? Witch☆
source:
Tomorrow is Halloween. Sorcier the witch was thinking about what to do with the werewolf, Rugal. For now, she decided that she would rather not think about it for the day.

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29265]Freem![/url]]
translation:
明天就是萬聖節了。魔女Sorcier正想著該如何對待狼人Rugal。不過眼下，她決定今天先不想這件事。

[譯自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29265]Freem![/url]]
